name: Bottenhavet + The Big Rip // Live
description:
After their phenomenal appearances at Desert Fest, the combo Bottenhavet and The Big Rip lands at Brewgata for date to remember!

Bottenhavet:
As the latest addition to Fuzzorama Records Stockholm based Bottenhavet is taking a big leap onto the stoner/fuzz/rock scene with their
debut album 'Ljud i Tysta Rum'. Musically, Bottenhavet strives to deliver a unique and diverse sound to your ears but always with the roots in
rock. Some people would describe the sound as 70’s hard rock, but with various influences shining through, including stoner, prog and grunge.

https://open.spotify.com/artist/2kA0uC0XeZORs8jtAAPRV4?si=3XwEsX5bSKmTcPItEykYcw

The Big Rip:
The Big Rip is a five-piece stoner-rock band hailing from
the industrial city of Porsgrunn, Norway. The band was
formed in 2021, and since then they have been delivering
their groovy, and heavy stoner sound.
